checks.finding: No independent body-q or body-load argument; the public API dispatches the original mean controller.
fixed_rigid only, body ux/uy added to fixed union, unchanged phase arrays and thickness-integrated N.
The same s drives affine lift and mean target d0+s. Moving body q with fixed mechanism mean is not provided by these options.
One mean column and one actuator multiplier; full unsymmetrized residual Jacobian with sparse LU.
Old fixed-body state cannot be silently resumed under new physics; a separately declared bridge needs old source pins and fresh q=0 feasibility/equilibrium validation.

Production Newton acceptance applies finite fields, J>0, free force relative residual<=tolerance and mean constraint<=its scaled bound. Global balance and prescribed displacement thresholds are wrapper gates.
Cached wrapper rejects J<=0, residual>1e-9, mean-bound violation, global balance>1e-6, or max compensated fixed displacement>8e-11 mm. These are not all native_evaluate built-in failure gates.

Original real task: tolerance1e-9, constraint_tolerance1e-10, displacement floor1e-6 mm, force floor factor1e-8, maxchecks25/backtracks12/bisections4, minimum_increment0.00625 mm; options mechanical/chunk256/port_projection.

minimal_implementation.control: body q prescribed independently; mechanism d_hold=1.06 mm fixed
minimal_implementation.unknowns: non-body free fluctuations plus existing input actuator multiplier

proposed_new_checks.check: Default fixed_rigid construction, parser rejection, old zero-fixed guard and strict resume retain old behavior; new mode is explicit and cannot enter via old extend_path.
Fix body membership once from the reference overlay; no support/port/body conflict, body-y/background-y overlap deduplicated. Distinguish all prescribed DOFs from zero-only DOFs.

Every body ux uses identical stored q lift and zero fluctuation; every body uy remains zero. Check each compensated physical ux-q and uy, not just a nodal average; maximum error<=8e-11 mm. Do not release individual body nodes.
Every original zero support/entity/background component remains compensated physical zero<=8e-11 mm; do not apply the old zero target to moving body ux.
Compensated b_in dot(lift+w)-d_hold <=1e-10*max(abs(d_hold),1e-6 mm) at every accepted q. q never replaces or increments d_hold.

Non-body free residual r=fint-b_in*R (k_out=0) normalized exactly as original, using d_hold in the force floor, <=1e-9; all J>0 and all recorded fields finite. Individual constrained body force need not vanish.
A_half_x=sum body r_x is actuator-on-body generalized force; model-on-body Fx=-sum body fint_x. With no other body external load they cancel. No nodal averaging or extra thickness factor.

Whole-domain force balance uses zero-support/guide/body-actuator/input exactly once and remains <=1e-6 under the original balance scale. Preserve total/material/Hu summaries and signed half-body reports; guide reaction is not free-body load support.

Explicit new-task q=0 start admits only pinned old split components and multiplier as a candidate; preserves body/source IDs and settings; independently checks body/mean constraints, performs fresh F/T, and passes gates before q advances. No old tangent or inherited qualification. Admission absent => do not pretend ordinary saved resume works.

For prescribed q eliminate body correction DOFs; predictor includes -(K deltaL)_free and constant-input constraint correction. The force tangent stays nonsymmetric. Small-model finite directional residual comparison should inspect the actual residual Jacobian, not an energy Hessian.
Any terminal error retains accepted q states and reason; timeout/zero mode/nonconvergence never classified release or capacity limit.

Observer stores reference and actual x=X+q, y=Y for body and actual split deformation for mechanism/medium; no remasking/rebuilding the body by moved center; old fixed-only observer cannot be silently reused.
